title: Kiteworks QBR / Platform Reliability Check-in
next_steps: Redwood to confirm runtime version on dedicated eu-west and recommend upgrade if below 2.18.3
Customer to share 2-3 request IDs where streaming stalled
transcript:
Meeting header
Date: 2025-11-08
Time: 18:30 UTC
Duration: 32 minutes
Attendees: Rachel Kim (Redwood), Chloe Martin (Redwood), Samir Desai (Kiteworks), Leah Nguyen (Kiteworks)

Summary
- Customer reports intermittent streaming stalls (SSE) where tokens stop arriving mid-response while the connection appears open.
- Redwood suspects known backpressure/flush behavior in older runtime versions; mitigation is runtime upgrade + keepalive chunks.

Transcript
[00:00] Rachel Kim: Thanks for joining. Wanted to do a quick QBR-ish check-in on reliability and any pain points.
[00:18] Samir Desai: Overall good. One thing thats been annoying is streaming. Like the stream just stops. It looks hung in our UI.
[00:33] Chloe Martin: When you say stops, do you mean you get an error or it just stalls?
[00:38] Leah Nguyen: It stalls. No done event. The HTTP thing is still open, but we stop receiving tokens.
[00:52] Chloe Martin: Got it. Thats consistent with what weve seen in a couple other places. Roughly how often?
[01:01] Leah Nguyen: Maybe a few percent under load. More common on long answers.
[01:18] Rachel Kim: Are you on the OpenAI compatible endpoint with stream=true?
[01:22] Samir Desai: Yes.
[01:30] Chloe Martin: Can you share a few request IDs and approximate timestamps? That helps us correlate with gateway and worker logs.
[01:42] Leah Nguyen: Yep, we can send those after.
[02:05] Rachel Kim: We have a suspected fix in newer runtime that adds keepalive chunks and avoids a backpressure dead-end. Well confirm your version and get you upgraded if needed.
[02:26] Samir Desai: Great. Workaround is non-streaming but thats worse UX.
[02:33] Chloe Martin: Understood. Lets do the upgrade path; well coordinate a window.
[31:10] Rachel Kim: Recap: youll send request IDs; well confirm runtime version and propose upgrade.
